title: FREESURFER MRITessellate

in_file.desc: Input volume to tessellate voxels from.

label_value.desc: Label value which to tessellate from the input volume. (integer, if input is "filled.mgz" volume, 127 is rh, 255 is lh)

out_file.desc: output filename or True to generate one

tesselate_all_voxels.desc: Tessellate the surface of all voxels with different labels

use_real_RAS_coordinates.desc: Saves surface with real RAS coordinates where c_(r,a,s) != 0

description: Uses Freesurfer's mri_tessellate to create surfaces by tessellating a given input volume
